messages:
Maya P: Quick question — promo cycle timeline for IC promotions? Evidence packs due Wed Apr 9 and manager calibration on Apr 16. Also need to confirm comp-change effective date vs payroll cutoff. @People Ops

People Ops: Thanks @Maya P — comp changes are effective the first of the month following approvals. For this cycle that means salary changes will show on payroll starting Jun 1. Payroll cutoff (to hit Jun 1) is May 20. Link to checklist: https://internal.redwood/corp/promo-checklist

Jordan L: Can we request an earlier effective date if the manager wants the promo to start May 1 (for retention reasons)?

People Ops: Short answer: usually no. We can do exceptions for critical retention cases but they require VP sign-off + compensation budget approval and must be requested by May 10 to make payroll. We'll run exceptions on a case-by-case basis.

Leah S: What about EMEA promotions — different payroll cadence? Any different deadlines?

People Ops: Yes — EMEA payroll runs monthly but with a different cutoff. For EMEA, to hit Jun payroll the request needs to be approved by May 12. If you're in UK/EEA, ping me and I'll confirm specific country cutoff.

ryan: What exactly should be in the evidence pack? Someone said we need a 'comp rationale' doc + before/after role scope.

People Ops: Evidence pack = manager writeup (1–2 paragraphs), updated role summary, comp rationale (market data + peer comparisons), recent performance examples, and new comp band recommendation. Put files in this folder and name them: `lastname_firstname_evidence.pdf`

Maya P: Got it — is there a calibration rubric we follow?

People Ops: Yes — use the 'Leveling & Calibration Rubric' (link in checklist). HR will run calibration on Apr 16 and share outcomes in the calibration notes doc. Expect some re-bands during calibration.

hr-bot: calendar: Promo calibration meeting created — Apr 16 09:00-11:00 UTC. Attendees: People Ops, Eng managers, Finance.

Jordan L: Thanks — pinging managers to get packs in by EOD Tue.

People Ops: Appreciated. If anyone needs an exception or has questions, DM me or post here. :thumbsup:
